run_iteration: run one PSRO meta trainer iteration to update agents, empirical gamestate, and meta strategies
sample_episodes: sample episodes with given policies and return average episode returns across players
get_meta_strategies: get the Nash equilibrium distribution on the meta game matrix for each player
get_meta_game: get the empirical meta game payoff matrix for all players
get_policies: get the current list of policies for each player in the meta trainer
